manifest_search_review.conclusion: The correction directly addresses the historical false match without changing saved records, group membership, API contracts or custody.
evidence: Record fields and location values keep normalized substring matching; status label/code is evaluated separately through normalized word prefixes.
The historical original B case cannot satisfy B from the middle of the Portuguese status recebido; the original test remains intact and the new test names that same regression explicitly.
Every query term must still match within one record/status combination; a nested matching item returns its entire saved root group.
Received-with-damage and physically-returned-with-damage filters remain based on exact actual persisted states.
shipmentRows sorts the filtered copy, while groups sorts a copied line list; neither helper rewrites original items or persisted status values.
manifest_search_review.semantic_limit: Prefix matching deliberately narrows status fragments: arbitrary middle/suffix fragments are no longer matches unless present in ordinary record fields. Full raw status codes and visible status-word prefixes remain available. This is a search behavior change, not a permission or persistence change.

preparation_review.conclusion: The additions preserve explicit packing selection and identity; they translate UI copy and normalize search without altering underlying values.
evidence: NFD accent removal and case folding apply to both query and searchable presentation strings only; original names, references, IDs and versions remain unchanged.
Search/clear/navigation redraw the view without calling notify or changing chosen; only an explicit selection/removal calls notify.
Complete-root selection, child inclusion, missing-ID rejection, record counts and exact id/version output remain unchanged.
Added text wrappers affect labels, aria-labels, empty/missing messages and review labels; element textContent continues to render stored names as text.
Zero quantity is preserved by null comparison; no quantity inference or summation was introduced.
Existing focus behavior, accessible selected-child explanation and disabled inherited-child selection remain present.
